parameters.formDescription: Writes a Tag value onto every row of an existing ClayRoots table. Never creates the Tag column: a table without one fails and nothing is written. Re-runnable and idempotent: a table already carrying the tag gets zero writes.

values.placeholder: YYYY-MM-DD, leave blank for the whole table

values.formSubmittedText: Run started. The Hub run-log row carries the result.

parameters.content:
## Guards, fail closed

Every refusal throws and the message ends with "Nothing was written."

- Base id or table id malformed
- No Tag value supplied
- Build Date filter is not YYYY-MM-DD
- Table id does not resolve in the base
- No literal Tag column on the table, or Tag is computed
- A Build Date filter was asked for but the table has no Build Date column

The Tag column is NEVER created here. Field creation stays with the Operator, by hand.

## The page loop

100 records per page, only the Tag field is read back, write batches of 10 at 4 requests per second. Only counters survive a page: the row set is dropped before the next fetch. Counters live in workflow static data keyed by execution id and are deleted when the log row is written.

Writes are plain PATCH updates by record id. Never an upsert. Build Date is a CREATED_TIME() formula across the estate and is never in a payload: any write to it returns HTTP 422.

The optional Build Date filter runs server-side as filterByFormula IS_SAME({Build Date}, DATETIME_PARSE(date), 'day'). The API returns Build Date as a full ISO timestamp even though it displays as a date, so this is a date-mode comparison, never a string match.
